standard-dialogue.player: How do I use the agility course?

standard-dialogue.npc: I'll throw you a stick, which you need to fetch as quickly as possible, from the area beyond the pipes.
Be wary of the deathslide - you must hang by your teeth, and if your strength is not up to the job you will fall into a pit of spikes. Also, I would advise not carrying too much extra weight.
Bring the stick back to the werewolf waiting at the end of the death slide to get your agility bonus.
I will throw your stick as soon as you jump onto the first stone.

when-not-wearing-the-ring-of-charos.npc: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!

overhead-dialogue-when-jumping-on-the-fi.npc: Why didn't you hand the stick over?!!?
